stdout:
usage: compass-c observe-experiment [-h] --revision REVISION --experiment
                                    EXPERIMENT --event-id EVENT_ID
                                    --observation-file OBSERVATION_FILE
                                    [--apply] [--full]
                                    plan_id

positional arguments:
  plan_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --revision REVISION
  --experiment EXPERIMENT
                        experiment ID in the saved proposal
  --event-id EVENT_ID   stable observation identity within this decision
  --observation-file OBSERVATION_FILE
                        bounded UTF-8 sourced observation JSON
  --apply               record the event once and invalidate affected
                        reasoning
  --full                include prior and posterior models and the supplied
                        observation
